messages:
Alex W: RFC draft posted — Optimize Toolkit (batching / caching / quant recommendations). Short PRD + acceptance checklist below. Ping @Priya S @Marco G for quick review. TL;DR: prioritize prefix caching + a small set of quant profiles for low-latency customer flows.

Priya S: Nice. Can you add customer-facing acceptance criteria? e.g., p95 latency targets, allowable quality delta, and clear rollback gates. Also call out privacy/tenant isolation for caching.

Marco G: Quick note — prefer 'recommendation' rather than auto-apply quant conversions. We should ship UI + CLI hooks for ops to opt-in. Also: Do we require per-model quant artifact storage?

Janet L: Acme (customer) asked for deterministic output after quantization — they saw hallucination spikes with 4-bit. Propose acceptance: quality regression <= 2% on our eval suite, and no regressions in the top-3 intent metrics.

Alex W: Uploaded PRD excerpt to the doc and pasted checklist snippet here. Acceptance (proposed):
- Quality: eval loss delta <= +0.02 and task-specific metric drop <= 2% vs baseline FP16.
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for short interactive chats (<= 128 tokens).
- Cost: unit token cost reduction >= 20% vs FP16 baseline for targeted configs.
- Stability: regression alerting within 1h and auto-roll after 24h if daily eval drift > 1.5%.
Edge cases: streaming + prefix cache cold-miss, multi-turn where user edits prefix, long-context KV cache eviction.

Priya S: Add rollback criterion: if production evals exceed 1.5% quality regression over a 24h window for the canary cohort, automatic fallback to previous model/FP config. Also require a canary A/B plan (5% traffic) and synthetic replay test.

Marco G: Security/privacy item: caching must be per-customer namespace with explicit opt-out. TTLs configurable, and cached artifacts encrypted with KMS for Private deployments. Add to PRD.

Janet L: Test plan suggestions:
- Unit: sample-level loglikelihood comparisons on 1k prompts.
- Perf: cold vs warm cache latencies + batching matrix (batch sizes 1/4/16/64).
- Quality: embed-distance checks (cosine >= 0.98) and top-3 intent match rate.
- Chaos: simulate KV cache evictions during a burst.

Alex W: On quant profiles: propose shipping three vetted profiles: 8-bit post-training quant (baseline), 4-bit tuned profile (opt-in), and a mixed-precision profile for long-context. Each profile must have a regression report and calibration seeds. Ops teams get hooks to pin models per-customer.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot updated staging/optkit with quant-profiles/v0.3 for QA — see https://ci.internal/release/optkit/v0.3 :white_check_mark:

Priya S: One more: define acceptable failure modes and messaging. If caching serves stale prefix after user edit, we must detect divergence and invalidate within 1s for interactive sessions. If not possible, mark as unsupported for interactive flows.

Marco G: Flag: automated quant conversion risk — recommend a one-click 'simulate' mode that runs a 10k prompt eval before enabling for live traffic. Document the compute cost.

Janet L: Customer acceptance criteria addendum for Acme: run a 48h shadow run against their production traffic; their SLOs are stricter, so require 0.5% quality delta.

Alex W: Thanks all — I'll integrate these edits and push an updated PRD + acceptance checklist by EOD. If no major objections, we'll slot this into the roadmap planning meeting on Tue.

Priya S: LGTM, small wording nit in the rollback section but nothing blocking.

Marco G: +1. Also scheduling note: need eng-runtime sign-off for kernel selection and perf counters.

Janet L: +1, will coordinate with Acme success team to schedule the shadow run.

ops-bot: incident-bot: created task OPTKIT-42 to track QA & canary plan

Alex W: Awesome — closing loop here. I'll @mention eng-runtime and product in the PR.
